source_guards.source_inventory_boundary: Checks frozen code and saved initial constraints; not an external syscall monitor.

mechanics.boundary: Two bounded actuator channels; branch torques are passive transmission. Numerical split defects are reported, not assumed zero; no hardware parameter identification.

outcome_and_media.approximation_scope: Common-shaft branch-elastic proxy has four hand generalized coordinates plus one virtual-shaft coordinate. No commercial DH3 hardware accuracy claim.

runs.statistics_boundary: Each condition is one deterministic trial; time-window frames are correlated. No confidence interval or hardware-calibration claim.

findings: Equation returns all three branch reactions to the same finite-inertia shaft; not three independently powered servos.
Branch torque sum may transiently exceed .6Nm by releasing stored shaft/spring energy; do not misclassify as extra motor power.
Shaft position clipping is an internal inelastic stop, not a hand/object reset; its numerical energy residual must be reported.
This permits cross-finger elastic deflection and is explicitly an engineering proxy, not identified commercial DH3 linkage.
Inherited fixture summary must map virtual shaft to finger1_joint when identifying active torque slots.
Actuator power is shaft_motor_torque_Nm*shaft_v_before_step_rad plus spread motor power; physical finger1 velocity is not shaft velocity.
